sections.title: Player win rates
sections.tldr: GRCX leads at 63.9%, ragnarneves trails at 36.1%, on 36 games. One standard error is about 8 points.

sections.title: Duo win rates
sections.tldr: Best pairing: GRCX + RikiPlancha12 at 75.0% (6-2). Worst: BabyGolem + ragnarneves at 25.0% (2-6). Every duo has few games, so none of this is settled.

sections.title: Champion win rates
sections.tldr: 91 distinct champions in 144 player-games. Best with >= 2 games: Sylas 100.0% (4-0), Dr. Mundo 100.0% (3-0), Lillia 100.0% (3-0).

sections.title: Tilt tracker
sections.tldr: After a loss: 45.0% (60 games). After a win: 55.0% (60 games). Losses are followed by more losses, but within sampling noise.

sections.title: Session fatigue
sections.tldr: 6 sessions, longest 10 games. Late-session samples are small and biased. Biggest drop from games 1-3 to 4+: BabyGolem (61.1% to 44.4%).

sections.title: Time of day
sections.tldr: 25 of 36 games began between 00:00 and 05:59.

sections.title: Game length buckets
sections.tldr: Short: 2 games, mid: 29, long: 5. Best in short games: GRCX (100.0%). Best in long games: GRCX (80.0%).

sections.title: Stomp vs throw
sections.tldr: Average game 16:36; shortest 10:18 (won by GRCX + BabyGolem), longest 24:47 (won by GRCX + BabyGolem). Widest loss-vs-win length gap: GRCX (+49 s).

sections.title: Multikills
sections.tldr: GRCX leads with 31 multikills. Group: 85 doubles, 0 triples, 0 quadras, 0 pentas.

sections.title: First blood
sections.tldr: Teams with first blood won 52.8% (19-17); without it 47.2% (17-19). Most first-blood kills: GRCX (16).

sections.title: Combat profile
sections.tldr: Highest kill pace: GRCX (0.45/min). Highest death pace: BabyGolem (0.41/min), lowest: GRCX (0.38/min). Lowest damage per kill (kill-steal index): BabyGolem (4,407).

sections.title: Team share
sections.tldr: GRCX takes the largest damage share (56.0%); ragnarneves is the biggest punching bag (37,905 damage taken per game).

sections.title: Champion pool
sections.tldr: Widest pool: RikiPlancha12 (33 champions in 36 games). Narrowest: GRCX (favourite Tristana x4).

sections.title: Liability index
sections.tldr: Highest deaths per minute: Sejuani (0.55), then Vel'Koz (0.54), Kalista (0.51). Min 2 games.
